{{Quote|Move along, and I'll get back to my duties.|Commando Horchoba Tuain|<ref name="SWG:TtR" />}}
'''Horchoba Tuain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was part of an Alliance operation to attack the [[Talus Imperial Outpost|Imperial Outpost]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Tuain was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent sent by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]] to stop the attack.<ref name="SWG:TtR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Horchoba Tuain was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Horchoba Tuain was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:TtR" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
